snippet.title: Gauntlet 4 Quest Mode (Sega Genesis) Game Playthrough Retro game
snippet.description: Gauntlet IV is a remake of the original Gauntlet, released for the Mega Drive/Genesis, but with many new features and items that would be seen in future incarnations.
